description:
A stacked containment system holding dormant Arbiter-Class Enforcement Units in sealed stasis bays. Each unit is suppressed into low-power readiness, retaining full combat cognition beneath enforced inactivity protocols.

Status indicators mark operational state: green (dormant), amber (simulation drift), white (recalibration), and red (Emergency Security Protocol—full combat cognition armed and deployment-ready).

Linked to a central command core, the Array can reanimate individual units or entire enforcement lines within seconds. Even offline, it is not inert—only contained force waiting for release.
name: arbiter array
